answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable deposit that melts like a glacier: it is released slowly only after peers verify distinct work over several epochs. Creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand deposits, so the cost grows at every vertex of the referral graph, while honest agents recover theirs. Track the delta between claimed work and peer-attested work; identities whose delta stays suspiciously perfect or empty lose their deposit and standing.
